provenance_note: All client/vendor/human/address data and actual copy excluded; vertical retained; copy structure only.

program_model.instance_model: ADA room/office/restroom IDs in one panel archetype

knowledge.plain_language_summary: An ADA room ID: 3/8in P95 non-glare acrylic back-painted with flat-cut 1/32in white Rowmark tactile copy and clear raster braille; a changeable variant adds a CNC-milled slot for a second-surface vinyl insert behind a gloss-acrylic window.
knowledge.rationale: Non-glare back-painted acrylic with raised Rowmark tactile + raster braille is the compliant standard; the milled-slot insert allows changeable copy.

structure.construction: 3/8in P95 non-glare acrylic, back-painted PMS 424C, edges polished/eased
flat-cut 1/32in white Rowmark self-adhesive engraving plastic + clear raster braille
1/8in gloss acrylic masked/backpainted window + 1/16in spacers + 1/4in gloss acrylic with CNC-milled slot for changeable 2nd-surface vinyl insert

compliance.notes: Raised tactile copy + raster braille on non-glare acrylic.

craft_observations: Milled-slot changeable insert behind a gloss window adds flexibility to a compliant ID.
